bib.title: CodeT5: Identifier-aware Unified Pre-trained Encoder-Decoder Models for Code Understanding and Generation
bib.venue: Proceedings of the 2021 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP), pages 8696-8708

question: Can a unified T5-style encoder-decoder pre-trained on code with identifier-aware objectives serve both code understanding and generation tasks better than encoder-only or decoder-only models?
hypothesis: Exploiting identifier token-type information and bimodal NL-PL dual generation in a unified encoder-decoder gives better code semantics and NL-PL alignment than treating code as plain text.
contributions: One of the first unified encoder-decoder models (CodeT5) supporting code understanding and generation tasks, and multi-task learning
A novel identifier-aware pre-training objective (identifier tagging, masked identifier prediction) plus bimodal dual generation to align NL and PL
State-of-the-art results on fourteen sub-tasks in CodeXGLUE

method.summary: T5-architecture encoder-decoder pre-trained on CodeSearchNet plus extra C/C# from BigQuery with three alternating objectives (masked span prediction, identifier tagging, masked identifier prediction) then bimodal dual generation; fine-tuned per task or multi-task on CodeXGLUE.
method.task: code pre-training; CodeXGLUE summarization, generation, translation, refinement, defect detection, clone detection

datasets.name: CodeSearchNet + extra C/CSharp
datasets.source: CodeSearchNet (six PLs) plus C and CSharp collected from Google BigQuery GitHub repos
datasets.preprocessing: tree-sitter AST for identifier labels; reserved keywords filtered from identifier list; whole-word masking by sampling spans before subword tokenization; multi-rounds of data cleaning (unspecified)

datasets.name: CodeXGLUE tasks (CodeSearchNet summarization, Concode, Java-C# translation, Tufano refinement small/medium, Devign defect, BigCloneBench-style clone from Wang et al. 2020)

models.name: CodeT5-small
models.tokenizer: byte-level BPE trained on pre-training data

other.pretrain_data: 470M Python and 210M Java functions, 47M StackOverflow NL posts

models.name: CodeBERT, GraphCodeBERT, RoBERTa, RoBERTa (code), DOBF, GPT-2, CodeGPT-2, CodeGPT-adapted
models.init_from: CodeGPT-adapted from GPT-2 checkpoint; CodeGPT-2 from scratch

training.objective: Pre-train: alternate (equal probability) MSP, identifier tagging (BCE), masked identifier prediction, 100 epochs; then bimodal dual generation (NL->PL and PL->NL) 50 more epochs. MSP: 15% corruption, span length 1-5 uniform (avg 3). Multi-task fine-tune: task control code prefix, balanced sampling q_i = r_i^alpha / sum r_j^alpha, alpha=0.7.
training.compute: training CodeT5-base produced around 49.25 kg CO2 (offset by provider, Google Cloud)

other.finetune: grid search over learning rate, training steps, batch size, selected on validation set; values not reported
other.multitask: covers all downstream tasks except clone detection; best checkpoint selected per task
other.understanding_heads: defect: label generated as unigram target; clone: last decoder state embedding similarity following Lewis et al. 2020

inference.prompting: task control code prefix e.g. 'Translate Java to CSharp:' in multi-task setting

metrics.name: smoothed BLEU-4
metrics.definition: Lin and Och 2004; summarization, translation, refinement, generation

metrics.name: CodeBLEU
metrics.definition: Ren et al. 2020: n-gram plus syntactic and semantic match

metrics.name: Clone F1
metrics.definition: Java clone data from Wang et al. 2020

eval.protocol: CodeXGLUE public data and splits; baseline numbers taken from original papers and the CodeXGLUE paper; single run, no seeds or significance tests stated

availability.data: CodeSearchNet and CodeXGLUE public; extra C/CSharp from BigQuery

evidence.quote: on a cluster of 16 NVIDIA A100 GPUs with 40G memory

results.note: Text says 'around 4.7 points' over PLBART; best variant gap is 5.58, CodeT5-base without dual-gen is 43.20 (4.68 gap).

limits: Fine-tuning hyperparameters (learning rate, steps, batch size) are chosen by grid search but never reported; optimizer, warmup, weight decay, dropout, seeds and layer/hidden/head sizes are not stated.
Baseline numbers are copied from other papers; single runs with no variance or significance tests.
Dual-gen and multi-task do not help or slightly hurt PL-PL and understanding tasks; multi-task also drops code generation.
BLEU is acknowledged as imperfect for code (Fig 3); no execution-based evaluation (no pass@k).
Authors note possible dataset bias, sensitive information leakage and automation bias.

terms.definition: T5-style span masking with 15% corruption, spans 1-5 tokens, predicted with sentinel tokens at the decoder
Binary sequence labelling of whether each code token is an identifier, from encoder hidden states
Mask all identifiers with one unique sentinel per identifier (obfuscation) and predict the mapping autoregressively
Train NL->PL and PL->NL as two instances per NL-PL pair with language ids

lineage.work: Exploring the limits of transfer learning with a unified text-to-text transformer (T5)
